title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 装备制造与强化无需金钱 / Craft and Upgrade Without Money
source_cheat_name: 装备制造&强化不需要钱
source_semantics: The original ARM cheat globally routes a category-pointer helper to its zero/default path and suppresses the insufficient-money flag. V1 mapped those global effects literally, but gameplay proved that the shared JP-v96 category dispatcher also feeds weapon attack and status-panel display. V2 narrowed production to both direct cost-wrapper call sites and passed gameplay. V3/V4 added two legacy upgrade-record cost callers, but V5/V6 then guessed generic detail-render calls and repeatedly failed: cold-start logs and live guest-memory reads proved every declared V6 write was present while the smithy still showed its native upgrade price. The V7 investigation searched the live guest heap for the displayed big-endian price, set a hardware read watchpoint on the exact field, and recovered guest renderer PC 0x026A74E4; static continuation 0x026A74F4 reads object +0x31C. The selected candidate record lives at the same object +0x27C. Builder 0x0221C730 clears ten output price words, maps every supported equipment category through 0x02159D14, and then populates that price array via exactly two category branches: 0x0221C850 calls 0x0221BE94 for category-map 0 and stores at 0x0221C854; 0x0221C96C calls 0x0221C4D4/0x0221B364 for category-map 1 and stores at 0x0221C970. The tested gunlance record category 0x0B maps to branch 1. V7 returns zero only at those two builder-local calls, retains the two production sites and two narrow legacy upgrade-record sites, and removes all four disproven generic render patches. Generic equipment value, sale/refund callers, attack-sensitive dispatch, and the wallet adjuster remain native. On 2026-08-12 the user cold-started the installed V7 pack and confirmed that the previously failing upgrade path now works; this supplies gameplay proof in addition to the runtime targeting closure.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Equipment - Craft Upgrade No Money

summary: 中文：V1 的全局类别分派补丁虽能免费加工，却会把攻击力和人物面板清零；V2 已通过生产，V3/V4 只覆盖旧强化记录，V5/V6 又误把通用详情值调用当成加工价格渲染，连续实测失败。2026-08-12 本机冷启动与客机内存已确认 V6 八点全部写入，但材料充足的强化仍显示 75000z。随后在客机堆中定位显示价格，硬件读监视点恢复出当前渲染器从所选对象 +0x31C 读取价格；同一对象 +0x27C 是候选记录。真实候选生成器 0x0221C730 先清零十个价格字，再在类别映射 0/1 分支分别通过 0x0221C850 与 0x0221C96C 计算并写回价格；实测铳枪类别 0x0B 走后者。V7 保留两个生产和两个旧强化局部费用点，新增这两个真实候选价格调用，并删除四个错误的通用详情补丁。2026-08-12 用户本机冷启动复测确认此前失败的强化路径已正常生效；默认关闭，Runtime Verified / Gameplay Passed。 / English: V1 made processing free via a global category dispatch but zeroed attack/status displays; V2 passed production, V3/V4 covered only legacy upgrade records, and V5/V6 repeatedly misidentified generic detail-value calls as the processing-price renderer. Cold-start and live-memory evidence on 2026-08-12 proved all eight V6 writes were present while a sufficient-material upgrade still showed 75000z. A live heap search plus hardware read watchpoint then recovered the active renderer reading selected object +0x31C, with the candidate record at the same object +0x27C. Actual builder 0x0221C730 clears ten price words and repopulates them through category-map 0/1 calls at 0x0221C850 and 0x0221C96C; tested gunlance category 0x0B takes the latter. V7 keeps two production and two legacy upgrade-local sites, adds these two actual candidate-price calls, and removes four disproven generic-detail patches. On 2026-08-12 the user cold-started the local installation and confirmed that the previously failing upgrade path now works; disabled by default, Runtime Verified / Gameplay Passed.
